title: L-bracket 3 mm off centre: the imprint stops short, a drafted V-funnel centres it
summary: Three recorded episodes of the v2 training suite (train_v2), all on the L-bracket at placement c2 (the part 3 mm off centre across the jaw), each the condition's first jitter seed: the stock blade, the configurator imprint and a drafted V-funnel recipe (design sobol_00 of the GV3 calibration sample, a random design, not a search result). The hero screen found no part where the stock blade fails visibly, so this is the offset contrast the hero rule prescribes: the stock blade holds the bracket where it landed, the imprint jams short of its seat, and the V-funnel's drafted walls pull the bracket to centre. Single episodes, not a score. Replayed from the recordings, never re-simulated.
